sentences.text:
The present writ petition has been filed for issuance of direction upon the respondents to release the compensation amount in favour of the petitioner in terms with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 as his land appertaining to Khata No. 73, plot no. 607, Mouza- Panaidih, P.S. No. 124 measuring an area of 04 decimals as well as a Mahua tree standing over the land appertaining to Khata No. 84,
plot no. 664 of the said mouza, have been acquired for construction of railway line from Koderma to Giridih.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner came to know through the information provided to her by the Public Information Officer-cum-District Land Acquisition Officer, Giridih vide letter no. 866 dated 06.07.2022 under the Right to Information Act, 2005 that the compensation has been awarded to one Meghlal with respect to acquisition of land appertaining to Khata No. 73, plot no. 607 measuring an area of 0.04 acre.

So far as the compensation with respect to acquisition of Mahua tree standing over the land appertaining to Khata No. 84, plot no.
664 is concerned, the same has been awarded to one Rajo Singh son of Kari Singh.
Thus, the petitioner has been deprived of suitable compensation for acquisition of the aforesaid land as well as the tree.

3. Ms. Omiya Anusha, learned A.C. to A.A.G.-IA appearing on behalf of the State respondents, refers to relevant paragraphs of the counter affidavit filed on behalf of the respondent nos. 3 and 4 which read as under:
Muneja Khaton Wife Of Md. Rafique vs The State Of Jharkhand Through Its Chief ... on 3 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137000344/
1 "15.

That is humbly stated and submitted that the court of District Land Acquisition Officer, Giridih, vide its order dated 02.12.2022, rejected the claim of the petitioner for payment of compensation of Mahua tree situated at Khata No. 84, Plot no. 664 in view of the fact that the spot verification was done by the Amin in presence of the villagers and it was found that the Mahua tree is not situated at plot no. 664, rather it is situated at plot no. 662.

Further it was also held that as far as the second claim of the petitioner for compensation of land situated at Mouza- Panaidih, Thana No. 124,
Plot No. 607, Rakwa 0.0400 acre is concerned, no document or rent receipt was produced by the petitioner, however Meghlal Mahto produced rent receipts till 2010-11of the said land.
17.

That it is pertinent to mention here that the petitioner has also filed Land Acquisition Appeal Case No. 03/2023 and the same is still pending before the learned court of Principal District and Sessions Judge, Hazaribagh."

entities.text: Principal District and Sessions Judge, Hazaribagh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering that the petitioner has already filed Land Acquisition Appeal No. 03 of 2023 with respect to payment of compensation for acquisition of the aforesaid land as well as tree in question which is pending in the court of the Principal District &
Sessions Judge, Hazaribagh, I am not inclined to entertain the present writ petition.
5. The writ petition is accordingly dismissed.

Ritesh/ (Rajesh Shankar, J.)
